```{=html}
<style>
.w104-tf { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w104-tf .w104-row {
  display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; margin: 6px 0; padding: 6px 10px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
}
.w104-tf .w104-row.w104-right { border: 2px solid #2e7d32; }
.w104-tf .w104-row.w104-wrong { border: 2px solid #d81e2e; }
.w104-tf .w104-text { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.w104-tf .w104-btn {
  padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  cursor: pointer; font: inherit;
}
.w104-tf .w104-btn.w104-on { border: 2px solid #d81e2e; font-weight: 700; }
.w104-tf .w104-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 0.75rem; }
.w104-tf .w104-controls button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w104-tf .w104-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w104-tf .w104-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w104-tf .w104-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w104-tf .w104-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w104-tf .w104-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="iw w104-tf" id="w104">
  <div class="w104-rows"></div>
  <div class="w104-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w104-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w104-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w104-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w104-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w104-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w104-expl iw-expl" hidden>Log integrity is the integrity property of the CIA triad applied to the audit record: a copy that left the compromised host as it was written is beyond the attacker’s reach, so centralised collection is itself an integrity control — while Azure Resource Logs must first be enabled by a diagnostic setting — see <a href="#def-logintegrity">the definition of log integrity</a>.</div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w104');
  const rowsBox = root.querySelector('.w104-rows');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w104-msg');
  // [statement, isTrue]
  const ITEMS = [
    ['Centralised log collection is itself an integrity control, not only a convenience.', true],
    ['Azure Resource Logs are collected by default, just like the Activity Log.', false],
    ['A store that is append-only or write-once lets logs be added to, but not edited or deleted.', true],
    ['In the cloud, a log left on an ephemeral host vanishes with the host.', true],
    ['Log integrity is the confidentiality property of the CIA triad applied to the audit record.', false],
    ['Prolonged log retention raises storage cost and has privacy implications.', true]
  ];
  function clearMarks() {
    rowsBox.querySelectorAll('.w104-row').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('w104-right', 'w104-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w104-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function makeRow(text, ans) {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'w104-row'; row.dataset.ans = String(ans);
    const t = document.createElement('span');
    t.className = 'w104-text'; t.textContent = text;
    row.appendChild(t);
    ['True', 'False'].forEach(lab => {
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'w104-btn'; b.textContent = lab;
      b.dataset.val = lab === 'True' ? 'true' : 'false';
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        row.dataset.sel = b.dataset.val;
        row.querySelectorAll('.w104-btn').forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('w104-on', x === b));
        clearMarks();
      });
      row.appendChild(b);
    });
    return row;
  }
  ITEMS.forEach(it => rowsBox.appendChild(makeRow(it[0], it[1])));
  const rows = [...rowsBox.querySelectorAll('.w104-row')];
  root.querySelector('.w104-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    clearMarks();
    let right = 0, wrong = 0, open = 0;
    rows.forEach(r => {
      if (!r.dataset.sel) { open++; return; }
      if (r.dataset.sel === r.dataset.ans) { r.classList.add('w104-right'); right++; }
      else { r.classList.add('w104-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    if (right === rows.length) {
      msg.textContent = '✓ All ' + rows.length + ' statements judged correctly.';
      msg.classList.add('ok');
    } else if (wrong === 0) {
      msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + open + ' statement(s) still unanswered.';
    } else {
      msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — ' + right + ' of ' + rows.length + ' correct (wrong rows marked red).';
      msg.classList.add('bad');
    }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w104-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelector('.w104-expl').hidden = true;
    rows.forEach(r => {
      delete r.dataset.sel;
      r.querySelectorAll('.w104-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('w104-on'));
    });
    clearMarks();
  });
  root.querySelector('.w104-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    clearMarks();
    rows.forEach(r => {
      r.dataset.sel = r.dataset.ans;
      r.querySelectorAll('.w104-btn').forEach(b =>
        b.classList.toggle('w104-on', b.dataset.val === r.dataset.ans));
      r.classList.add('w104-right');
    });
    root.querySelector('.w104-expl').hidden = false;
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.classList.add('ok');
  });
})();
</script>
```
